businesses.business: commercial specialty insurance and title insurance

offering_description.value: Underwrites specialty property and casualty insurance for commercial clients, including general liability, workers' compensation, commercial auto and financial indemnity coverage. Also provides title insurance and escrow services for residential and commercial real estate transactions. Sells through brokers, agents and direct operations.

primary_products.value: specialty commercial insurance; workers' compensation insurance; commercial auto and general liability insurance; title insurance; financial indemnity coverage

primary_services.value: escrow and closing services; claims management; risk management and loss control; title search and settlement

customer_segment.value: B2B: commercial businesses, trucking firms, contractors, lenders, real estate companies; B2C: home buyers and property owners purchasing title insurance

end_markets.value: transportation and trucking; construction; real estate; general commercial businesses; financial services

revenue_model.value: interest or premiums: insurance premiums for specialty coverage and title policies, investment income on portfolio; service fees: title search, escrow and closing fees

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: risk-bearing insurance carrier taking premiums and underwriting risk for commercial clients and real estate parties; service provider: title search, escrow and claims services for real estate transactions

geography_served.value: North America: United States primarily, with operations in Canada

specialization.value: related lines: specialty insurance and title insurance, both insurance underwriting

distribution_channels.value: agents / brokers: independent insurance agents and brokers placing specialty coverage; direct sales: direct underwriting of commercial accounts and title orders from lenders and real estate professionals; own locations: title company branch offices
distribution_channels.category: agents / brokers; direct sales; own locations

regulatory_exposure.value: high: licensed insurers regulated by state insurance departments, solvency and rate rules, NAIC standards
